description: Conservative paper market maker: one active binary market, size both quote legs together against worst-case one-sided fills and remaining daily capital. Total inventory plus quotes is capped; completion must be profitable using actual inventory cost. Trade-tape volume limits simulated fills. Estimated rebates are disclosed but never credited to cash. Forward test only; profitability is unproven. Upstream-inspired revision: synchronized timestamped data and one-hour entry cooldown after two net losing markets in four hours; no increase in risk budget.

quoting.price_rule: Improve/join only while bid stays at least 0.5c below its own midpoint; round down to tick and cap pair cost at 98c.
quoting.inventory_rule: Quote the missing side only if actual average paid price plus new bid is at most 98c; never add to a completed pair.

fills.rule: Count qualifying taker volume after placement through expiry. At-price volume first consumes the initial queue; through-price volume is capped at observed shares. Missing/incomplete tape retains reservations and defers settlement; never assumes unfilled.
fills.fill_price: the order's own limit price (makers pay no fee)

rebates.note: Estimate displayed in decision metrics only; excluded from cash and performance after this version. Historical credits are preserved.

sizing.note: At most 6% equity per pair before risk caps, 3% worst-case market loss, 10% inventory plus quote cost, one active market. Daily remaining-risk and profit-protection floors also constrain quotes. Skip when 5-share minimum cannot fit; never inflate size. PAUSED in mm-2.2.0: no new quotes (max_open_markets=0); existing positions still settle. Reason: 2,306-market tape replay measured the quoting rule at about -0.7 per 10-share market (-13 s.e.), see research/review_2026_10_05/.

risk.note: Check current marks every run. Daily stops persist until the next New York date. After +2% daily peak gain, preserve half via an entry risk budget. Existing positions still settle; no guaranteed intraday liquidation.
